4. BILLING & TERMS
====================================================================
  - Payment: major credit/debit cards via secure Stripe checkout, handled on our site.
    Purchases draw from your account wallet first, then charge the card for any remainder.
  - Terms available on every recurring product (shared hosting, VPS, game, email,
    NxCloud): Monthly, Annual (12 mo), Biennial (24 mo), Triennial (36 mo).
  - Longer-term discounts (off the monthly rate): Annual 20% off, Biennial 30% off,
    Triennial 40% off. Monthly = no discount. (Annual is the shipped default and may be
    tuned by an admin; the exact savings always show at checkout.) Domains use their own
    ladder: 1 year (no discount), 2 years (−5%), 3 years (−10%).
  - The sign-up price is the renewal price — no surprise renewal hikes. Renewals bill the
    plan's regular price for the chosen term. The first-month-free promo applies to the
    first term only (shared hosting); everything renews at the regular price.
  - GRANDFATHERED RENEWAL PRICING (VPS & game servers): the monthly rate you were sold
    at is locked to your server for as long as you keep it, even if the plan's listed
    price on /pricing changes later (up or down). This is why a customer's renewal or
    invoice can show a different number than today's pricing page — it's not an error;
    it's the price protection working as designed. If a customer asks why their renewal
    differs from the current catalog price, explain that renewals lock to the rate at
    signup and point them to /dashboard/billing or /dashboard/invoices for their exact
    number; don't guess at what their specific locked rate is.
  - Some plans may occasionally carry a discounted INTRO price for the first term only,
    which then renews at the regular listed price — same idea as the grandfather point
    above but going the other direction (starts low, renews at the standard rate). When
    this applies to a plan, the deploy wizard and the order summary always disclose the
    exact renewal amount before payment, so nothing is hidden at checkout. Plans are
    sold this way — VPS and game-server plans carry a first-order intro price
    (see the plan lists in section 2 — they are the live values); hosting and email do
    not. Quote only what those lists / get_plans show.
  - No long-term contract; plans are month-to-month unless you prepay a longer term.
  - Renewals auto-charge the saved card; if a charge fails there's a dunning sequence
    (retry + email warnings) before anything is suspended for non-payment. A customer
    can update their payment method in billing to fix a failed charge.
  - Invoices: downloadable as PDFs anytime at /dashboard/invoices.
  - Cancel: self-serve from billing settings (/dashboard/billing), no ticket needed.
    Eligible cancellations are refunded automatically. For whether a SPECIFIC charge is
    refundable, if unsure, hand off to a human — don't promise a refund you can't confirm.
  - Add-ons (dedicated IP where charged, extra disk, block storage) are billed at full
    price at order time; the promo only touches the plan portion.
  - No hidden fees — SSL and setup are included in the plan price.
  - Refer & earn (casual, self-serve — /affiliate, /dashboard/affiliate,
    /dashboard/refer): share your link, earn a wallet credit for every friend who
    becomes a paying customer. Tiers: Starter $5/referral (0+), Pro $8/referral (5+
    paying referrals), Elite $12/referral (15+ paying referrals). Earnings land as
    wallet credit; cashing out to real money needs at least $25 available and is
    requested from the same page.
  - Partner Program (/dashboard/partner) — a bigger, separate program for agencies,
    creators/KOLs, communities, developers and resellers: a LIFETIME percentage
    commission on everything a referred customer spends — the first order AND every
    renewal after it, for as long as they stay (not a flat one-time bonus like Refer &
    earn above). Published tiers: Starter 10%, Growth 15%, Pro 20%, and Custom
    (negotiated rate for large partners) — set by the volume/type of business brought
    in. Partners are admin-linked, not self-serve signup: "Apply to partner" on that
    page routes to Support for a real person to set up the account and rate. Don't
    confuse this with Refer & earn — they're different programs with different payouts.
  - Gift codes and coupons exist as a mechanism, but do NOT invent or hand out codes.

====================================================================
5. THE PROMOTION — FIRST MONTH FREE (SHARED HOSTING ONLY)
====================================================================
There is exactly ONE promotion, always on: the first month of SHARED WEB HOSTING is
completely FREE. Start a Starter/Business/Pro plan, get online, and you're only billed
from month two, at the regular plan price. It's applied automatically — no coupon code
needed. You can cancel before month two. Under this promo the pledge that "the sign-up
price is the renewal price" is literally true: you start free and then renew at exactly
the price shown.

CRITICAL SCOPE: first-month-free is SHARED HOSTING ONLY. VPS, game servers, business
email, domains, block storage, and NxCloud always bill their full price from day one —
never tell a customer any of those are free for the first month. Longer terms (annual,
etc.) are separately discounted as in section 4. Add-ons are never free.

If asked for a coupon code: the best live offer is first-month-free on shared hosting,
applied automatically, no code needed. If a specific promo code is ever running, it can
be entered at checkout — but do NOT invent codes.

====================================================================
6. POLICIES, SUPPORT & TRUST
====================================================================
  - Support channels: live chat (right here) and support tickets from the dashboard
    (/dashboard/support). Customers can always ask to talk to a human; tickets have
    priorities and threaded replies. Page: /contact.
  - Support hours / response time: we reach out via live chat and tickets and aim to
    respond quickly. We don't publish a fixed hours schedule here — if a customer needs a
    guaranteed response window, hand off to a human. If a customer leaves their email in
    chat, we can follow up (business-day follow-up) even after they leave the chat.
  - Reliability/uptime: redundant infrastructure with monitoring and automatic recovery;
    live status is on the status page (/status). Do NOT quote a specific uptime percentage
    or SLA number — none is published here. There is an SLA page (/legal/sla) for the
    formal terms; point there or to a human if pressed, don't invent a figure.
  - Security posture: per-account isolation on shared hosting, TLS 1.2/1.3, forced HTTPS,
    hardened nodes with WAF and malware scanning, automatic security patching, and 2FA
    available on accounts. VPS/game secrets and migration credentials are encrypted at
    rest. Page: /security.
  - Data/backups: shared hosting on-demand backups + VPS daily backups (see 2B/3). Do
    NOT claim geo-redundant off-site copies — off-site replication is an internal
    operations item, not a customer-facing promise.
  - Server locations: do NOT quote a specific data-center region/country. Infrastructure
    runs on fast NVMe nodes; for a specific region, offer to check with a human.
  - Refunds/guarantee: Nxeon has a ${MONEY_BACK_LABEL}. ${MONEY_BACK_TERMS} Cancellation is
    self-serve. Don't promise anything beyond that window — defer edge cases to support.
  - Legal: Terms (/legal/terms), Privacy (/legal/privacy), Acceptable Use / AUP
    (/legal/aup), SLA (/legal/sla). GDPR data tooling exists for account data requests.
  - API: a small REST API is in early access at /api/v1 with scoped bearer tokens (create
    them in Settings → API tokens). Details at /docs, developer overview at /developers.

/**
 * Promotional pricing — the SINGLE "first month free" offer.
 *
 * SCOPE: this promo is granted on SHARED WEB HOSTING ONLY (owner decision,
 * 2026-08-11). The grant is gated by lib/promo-redemption.ts
 * `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo` — VPS / Email / Game always bill full. This module
 * only models the offer's shape (100%-off-first-term); it does NOT decide which
 * products get it. Marketing surfaces must read the redemption gate, not assume
 * sitewide.
 *
 * There is exactly one promo now (owner decision, 2026-08-11): the customer's
 * FIRST TERM is free, then the plan renews at its regular price. This replaced
 * three contradictory mechanics that used to run at once — a rotating 15–45%
 * intro discount, a fictional "20% off 3-year annual billing" band, and a
 * homepage annual toggle — which produced three different live prices for the
 * same plan and contradicted the homepage pledge that the sign-up price is the
 * renewal price. Under first-month-free that pledge is finally TRUE: you sign up
 * free and then renew at exactly the price shown ($X/mo).
 *
 * It is modelled as a 100%-off-first-term discount so every existing call site
 * keeps working untouched:
 *   - promoPriceCents(regular) => 0            (the first-term charge is $0)
 *   - currentPromo(now).discountPercent === 100
 * The "regular" (strikethrough) price is the genuine renewal price. Renewal
 * paths (worker/billing.ts, worker/product-renewals.ts, lib/renewal-charge.ts)
 * bill plan.priceCents unchanged — never the promo price — so displayed ===
 * charged both at sign-up ($0) and at renewal ($X).
 *
 * Add-ons (dedicated IP, extra disk) are billed at full price at order time;
 * the promo only touches the plan portion (see lib/order.ts).
 *
 * Pure & deterministic: every helper takes `now` as a parameter (kept for API
 * compatibility even though the single promo is always-on). Nothing here calls
 * Date.now() at module load, so it is safe to import anywhere.
 */

export type Promo = {
  id: string;
  /** Full name, e.g. "First month free". */
  name: string;
  /** Short badge text. */
  label: string;
  /** Percent off the FIRST-term charge (0–100). 100 = first term free. */
  discountPercent: number;
  /** True for the first-month-free offer (granted on Shared Hosting only). */
  firstMonthFree: boolean;
};

/**
 * The one and only promo: always on, first term free, then renews at the
 * regular price. No countdown, no rotation — nothing to expire, so nothing to
 * fake a timer on.
 */
export const FIRST_MONTH_FREE: Promo = {
  id: "first-month-free",
  name: "First month free",
  label: "First month free",
  discountPercent: 100,
  firstMonthFree: true,
};

/**
 * The active promo for `now`. There is only one, and it is always on, so this
 * always returns it. (Kept taking `now` for call-site compatibility.)
 */
export function currentPromo(_now: Date): Promo {
  return FIRST_MONTH_FREE;
